entries.title: Disjoint cutsets bound Bernoulli connections
entries.statement: DRAFT: author proof or explicit gap; independent mathematical review pending. For independent Bernoulli(p) bond percolation, n pairwise edge-disjoint finite x-y cutsets F_i imply P_p(x connected to y) <= product_i[1-(1-p)^|F_i|].

entries.title: Bounded cutsets cannot cover one-ended nonamenable graphs
entries.statement: DRAFT: author proof or explicit gap; independent mathematical review pending. For a connected locally finite one-ended graph with maximum degree d and edge Cheeger constant h_E>0, the number of disjoint x-y cuts of size at most K is at most d(|B_R(x)|+|B_R(y)|), R=ceil(K/h_E)+1. This is uniform in x,y on vertex-transitive graphs.

entries.title: Exact simple cyclic free-product percolation special case
entries.statement: DRAFT: author proof or explicit gap; independent mathematical review pending. For m>=3 and the simple Cayley graph of C_2*C_m with S={a,b,b^-1}, h_E>=1-2/m>0, p_u=1, and p_c is the unique p in (0,1) solving p[2 sum_{k=1}^{m-1}p^k-(m-1)p^m]=1.
assumptions: One undirected a-edge per involution pair

entries.title: Normalized spectral percolation criteria need the degree factor
entries.statement: DRAFT: author proof or explicit gap; independent mathematical review pending. For an infinite connected d-regular vertex-transitive undirected graph and normalized walk operator P=A/d with rho=||P||_2, pd rho<1 implies tau_p(x,y)<=(pd rho)^dist(x,y)/(1-pd rho), so pu>=1/(d rho). Thus pc<1/(d rho) suffices for pc<pu, without being necessary.
assumptions: Vertex transitivity for the uniqueness conclusion

entries.title: Unclosed barrier and merger obligation for C0047
entries.statement: DRAFT: author proof or explicit gap; independent mathematical review pending. The independent barrier-exploration attempt does not prove pc<pu for a general one-ended nonamenable Cayley graph. A fresh effective-barrier construction or quantitative nonmerger bound at some p>pc is still required.
assumptions: All generating sets in the parent target are fixed; none substituted
No conditional products without derived filtration structure

relations.rationale: L4's bridge cuts satisfy L1's disjoint edge-index hypothesis; L2 then excludes uniqueness.
L3 gives a uniform finite bound on size-K cut multiplicity; the parent lane lacks a fresh-barrier replacement.

Scoped correction only: the prior concept says 'p_c < 1/rho (Benjamini-Schramm criterion)' with normalized rho. L5 proves the degree-scaled sufficient bound, while pc<=1<1/rho makes the prior reduction vacuous. No refutation of the parent conjecture.
